IF OBJECT_ID('D360.IBS_REFERENCE') IS NOT NULL

    [CIF_ID] [VARCHAR](20) NULL,
    [BusinessPortfolio] [VARCHAR](50) NULL,
    [CreditPortfolio] [VARCHAR](50) NULL,
    [PrimaryBankingOfficer] [VARCHAR](50) NULL,

IF OBJECT_ID('D360.IBS_ENTITY') IS NOT NULL
    DROP TABLE D360.IBS_ENTITY

CREATE TABLE D360.IBS_ENTITY
(
    EntityId BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
    LongName VARCHAR(255) NULL,
    ShortName VARCHAR(255) NULL,
    EntityType VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    BusinessPortfolio VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    CbcCifNumber VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    CreditPortfolio VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    Prospect VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    TaxId VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    CountryOfInc VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    CbcRegistrationDate DATE NULL,
    RegistrationNumber VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    CbcCooperativeId VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    ConnectedParty VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    CbcRelatedParty VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    Descriptions VARCHAR(500) NULL,
    CbcGroupName VARCHAR(255) NULL,
    CbcGroupId VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    CbcSingleBorrowerLimit BIGINT NULL,
    CbcBorrowerSince VARCHAR(50) NULL,
    CbcDepositorSince VARCHAR(50) NULL,
    LastReviewDate VARCHAR(50) NULL,
    NextReviewDate VARCHAR(50) NULL,
    Division VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    RestrictedEntity VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    PrimaryBankingOfficer VARCHAR(255) NULL,
    PrimaryCreditOfficer VARCHAR(255) NULL,
    CbcContactName VARCHAR(255) NULL,
    FirmType VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    CountryOfRisk VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    Currency VARCHAR(50) NULL,
    CbcFirmSize VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    CbcGenderOfCompany VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    ListingDate VARCHAR(50) NULL,
    CountryOfListing VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    StockExchange VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    StockCode VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    IndClassification VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    CbcNatureOfBusiness VARCHAR(255) NULL,
    Salutation VARCHAR(50) NULL,
    CbcFirstName VARCHAR(255) NULL,
    CbcMiddleName VARCHAR(255) NULL,
    CbcSuffix VARCHAR(50) NULL,
    CustomerSince VARCHAR(50) NULL,
    DateOfBirth VARCHAR(50) NULL,
    Nationality1 VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    CountryOfRes VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    Gender VARCHAR(50) NULL,
    CbcNoOfDependents INT NULL,
    CbcHomeOwnership VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    CbcOccupation VARCHAR(255) NULL,
    CurrentEmp VARCHAR(255) NULL,
    CbcEmploymentDate VARCHAR(50) NULL,
    Designation VARCHAR(255) NULL,
    BusinessType VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    CbcRelatedPartyClassIndividual VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    CbcIsNonSystemUser BIT NULL
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
    HEAP
);

WITH CURRENT_EMPLOYMENT AS (
    SELECT
        MI.ORGKEY,
        MI.STRTEXT2,
        MI.DTDATE1,
        MI.STRTEXT9,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY MI.ORGKEY
            ORDER BY MI.DTDATE1 DESC
        ) AS RN
    FROM EDS.CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO MI
    WHERE MI.TYPE = 'CURRENT_EMPLOYMENT'
)

INSERT INTO D360.IBS_ENTITY
(
    LongName,
    ShortName,
    EntityType,
    BusinessPortfolio,
    CbcCifNumber,
    CreditPortfolio,
    Prospect,
    TaxId,
    CountryOfInc,
    CbcRegistrationDate,
    RegistrationNumber,
    CbcCooperativeId,
    ConnectedParty,
    CbcRelatedParty,
    Descriptions,
    CbcGroupName,
    CbcGroupId,
    CbcSingleBorrowerLimit,
    CbcBorrowerSince,
    CbcDepositorSince,
    LastReviewDate,
    NextReviewDate,
    Division,
    RestrictedEntity,
    PrimaryBankingOfficer,
    PrimaryCreditOfficer,
    CbcContactName,
    FirmType,
    CountryOfRisk,
    Currency,
    CbcFirmSize,
    CbcGenderOfCompany,
    ListingDate,
    CountryOfListing,
    StockExchange,
    StockCode,
    IndClassification,
    CbcNatureOfBusiness,
    Salutation,
    CbcFirstName,
    CbcMiddleName,
    CbcSuffix,
    CustomerSince,
    DateOfBirth,
    Nationality1,
    CountryOfRes,
    Gender,
    CbcNoOfDependents,
    CbcHomeOwnership,
    CbcOccupation,
    CurrentEmp,
    CbcEmploymentDate,
    Designation,
    BusinessType,
    CbcRelatedPartyClassIndividual,
    CbcIsNonSystemUser
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(CORP.CORPORATE_NAME, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE COALESCE(CUST.CUST_LAST_NAME, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
    END AS LongName,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(CORP.SHORT_NAME, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE COALESCE(CUST.SHORT_NAME, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
    END AS ShortName,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(CORP.LEGALENTITY_TYPE, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE 'CUSTOMER'
    END AS EntityType,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(REF.BusinessPortfolio, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS BusinessPortfolio,

    CUST.ORGKEY AS CbcCifNumber,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(REF.CreditPortfolio, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CreditPortfolio,

    'N' AS Prospect,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(CORP.TAXID, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE COALESCE(CUST.GENERALTAXID, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
    END AS TaxId,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(CORP.COUNTRYOFINCORPORATION, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CountryOfInc,

    -- CASE
    --     WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
    --         THEN COALESCE(CORP.DATE_OF_INCORPORATION, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
    --     ELSE NULL
    -- END AS CbcRegistrationDate,
    NULL AS CbcRegistrationDate,

    -- CASE
    --     WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
    --         THEN COALESCE(CORP.REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
    --     ELSE NULL
    -- END AS RegistrationNumber,
    NULL AS RegistrationNumber,

    -- CASE
    --     WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
    --         THEN CORP.STRUSERFIELD10
    --     ELSE NULL
    -- END AS CbcCooperativeId,
    NULL AS CbcCooperativeId,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(CORP.STRUSERFIELD22, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE COALESCE(CUST.STRUSERFIELD22, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
    END AS ConnectedParty,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(CORP.STRUSERFIELD23, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE COALESCE(CUST.STRUSERFIELD23, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
    END AS CbcRelatedParty,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN CORP.STRUSERFIELD24
        ELSE CUST.STRUSERFIELD24
    END AS Descriptions,

    GHH.GROUPHOUSEHOLDNAME AS CbcGroupName,
    GHH.GROUPHOUSEHOLDID AS CbcGroupId,

    42680364174 AS CbcSingleBorrowerLimit,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN CORP.DATE4
        ELSE CUST.DTDATE4
    END AS CbcBorrowerSince,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN CORP.DATE3
        ELSE CUST.DTDATE5
    END AS CbcDepositorSince,

    NULL AS LastReviewDate,
    NULL AS NextReviewDate,
    NULL AS Division,
    'N' AS RestrictedEntity,
    
    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(REF.PrimaryBankingOfficer, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS PrimaryBankingOfficer,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(REF.PrimaryCreditOfficer, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS PrimaryCreditOfficer,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(CORP.KEYCONTACT_PERSONNAME, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CbcContactName,

    NULL AS FirmType,
    
    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(REF.CountryOfRisk, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CountryOfRisk,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(REF.Currency, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS Currency,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(FIN.STR7, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CbcFirmSize,

    NULL AS CbcGenderOfCompany,
    NULL AS ListingDate,
    NULL AS CountryOfListing,
    NULL AS StockExchange,
    NULL AS StockCode,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(REF.IndClassification, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS IndClassification,
    NULL AS CbcNatureOfBusiness,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN COALESCE(CUST.SALUTATION, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS Salutation,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN COALESCE(CUST.CUST_FIRST_NAME, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CbcFirstName,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN COALESCE(CUST.CUST_MIDDLE_NAME, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CbcMiddleName,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN COALESCE(CUST.NAMESUFFIX, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CbcSuffix,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN COALESCE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),CUST.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE,120), 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CustomerSince,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN COALESCE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),CUST.CUST_DOB,120), 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS DateOfBirth,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN COALESCE(DEMO.NATIONALITY, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS Nationality1,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN COALESCE(DEMO.RESIDENCE_COUNTRY, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CountryOfRes,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN COALESCE(CUST.GENDER, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS Gender,

    NULL AS CbcNoOfDependents,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN COALESCE(DEMO.RESIDENTIAL_STATUS, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CbcHomeOwnership,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN COALESCE(EMP.STRTEXT2, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CbcOccupation,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN COALESCE(DEMO.EMPLOYERSNAME, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CurrentEmp,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN COALESCE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), EMP.DTDATE1, 120), 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CbcEmploymentDate,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN COALESCE(EMP.STRTEXT9, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS Designation,

    NULL AS BusinessType,
    NULL AS CbcRelatedPartyClassIndividual,

    CAST(1 AS BIT) AS CbcIsNonSystemUser

FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM CUST

LEFT JOIN D360.IBS_REFERENCE REF
    ON REF.CIF_ID = CUST.ORGKEY

LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_CORPORATE CORP
    ON CORP.CORP_KEY = CUST.ORGKEY

LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD GHH
    ON GHH.ORGKEY = CUST.ORGKEY

LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_FINANCIAL FIN
    ON FIN.ORGKEY = CUST.ORGKEY

LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC DEMO
    ON DEMO.ORGKEY = CUST.ORGKEY

LEFT JOIN CURRENT_EMPLOYMENT EMP
    ON EMP.ORGKEY = CUST.ORGKEY
    AND EMP.RN = 1

WHERE CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE IN ('Corporate', 'Retail')
    AND CUST.STRUSERFIELD8 IS NOT NULL
    AND CUST.ISLATEST = 1;

SELECT * FROM D360.IBS_ENTITY ORDER BY EntityId

IF OBJECT_ID('D360.IBS_ENTITYOTHERINFO') IS NOT NULL
    DROP TABLE D360.IBS_ENTITYOTHERINFO

CREATE TABLE D360.IBS_ENTITYOTHERINFO
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
    HEAP
)
AS

WITH CIFS AS
(
    SELECT
        EntityId,
        CbcCifNumber
    FROM D360.IBS_ENTITY
)
SELECT
    CIFS.EntityId AS CbcEntityOtherInfoId,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100)) AS CbcAccountStrategy,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100)) AS CbcAfrd,
    CIFS.CbcCifNumber AS CbcCifNumber,
    'No' AS CbcFatcaTag,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100)) AS CbcHighRisk,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(500)) AS CbcHighRiskReason,
    'No' AS CbcInnovationDevelopment,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(500)) AS CbcInnovativeDevCreditRemark,
    COALESCE(
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), FIN.NUMBEROF_EMPLOYEES),
        'Mandatory to ILOS'
    ) AS CbcNoOfEmployees,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100)) AS CbcSubjectToRealEstateLimit,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(100)) AS CbcSustainableFinance,
    COALESCE(CORP.STRUSERFIELD6, 'Mandatory to ILOS') AS CbcTopTwentyThousandCorp
FROM CIFS
LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_FINANCIAL FIN
    ON CIFS.CbcCifNumber = FIN.ORGKEY
LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_CORPORATE CORP
    ON CIFS.CbcCifNumber = CORP.CORP_KEY;

SELECT * FROM D360.IBS_ENTITYOTHERINFO

IF OBJECT_ID('D360.IBS_ADDRESS') IS NOT NULL
    DROP TABLE D360.IBS_ADDRESS

CREATE TABLE D360.IBS_ADDRESS (
    [AddressId] BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
    [CbcCifNumber] VARCHAR(100),
    [AddressType] VARCHAR(100),
    [Address1] VARCHAR(500),
    [Address2] VARCHAR(500),
    [Country] VARCHAR(100),
    [State] VARCHAR(100),
    [City] VARCHAR(100),
    [Zip] VARCHAR(50)
)

WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
    HEAP
);

INSERT INTO D360.IBS_ADDRESS (
    [CbcCifNumber],
    [AddressType],
    [Address1],
    [Address2],
    [Country],
    [State],
    [City],
    [Zip]
)

SELECT DISTINCT
    COALESCE(CUST.ORGKEY, 'Mandatory to ILOS') AS CbcCifNumber,
    COALESCE(ADDR.ADDRESSCATEGORY, 'Mandatory to ILOS') AS AddressType,

    CASE 
        WHEN ADDR.PREFERREDFORMAT = 'STRUCTURED_FORMAT' THEN
            CASE WHEN ADDR.SUBURB IS NULL
                AND ADDR.PREMISE_NAME IS NULL
                AND ADDR.BUILDING_LEVEL IS NULL
                AND ADDR.STREET_NAME IS NULL THEN 'Mandatory to ILOS'
            ELSE CONCAT(
                    ADDR.SUBURB, ' ',
                    ADDR.PREMISE_NAME, ' ',
                    ADDR.BUILDING_LEVEL, ' ',
                    ADDR.STREET_NAME
            )
            END
        ELSE
            COALESCE(ADDR.ADDRESS_LINE1, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
    END AS Address1,

    CASE 
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate' THEN
            CASE 
                WHEN ADDR.PREFERREDFORMAT = 'STRUCTURED_FORMAT' THEN
                    CASE WHEN ADDR.SUBURB IS NULL
                        AND ADDR.PREMISE_NAME IS NULL
                        AND ADDR.BUILDING_LEVEL IS NULL
                        AND ADDR.STREET_NAME IS NULL THEN 'Mandatory to ILOS'
                    ELSE CONCAT(
                        ADDR.SUBURB, ' ',
                        ADDR.PREMISE_NAME, ' ',
                        ADDR.BUILDING_LEVEL, ' ',
                        ADDR.STREET_NAME
                    ) 
                    END
                ELSE
                    CASE WHEN ADDR.ADDRESS_LINE2 IS NULL
                        AND ADDR.ADDRESS_LINE3 IS NULL THEN 'Mandatory to ILOS'
                    ELSE CONCAT(
                            ADDR.ADDRESS_LINE2, ' ',
                            ADDR.ADDRESS_LINE3, ' ',
                            ADDR.PREFERREDFORMAT
                    ) 
                    END
            END
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail' THEN
            CASE WHEN ADDR.ADDRESS_LINE2 IS NULL
                AND ADDR.ADDRESS_LINE3 IS NULL THEN 'Mandatory to ILOS'
            ELSE CONCAT(
                ADDR.ADDRESS_LINE2, ' ',
                ADDR.ADDRESS_LINE3
            )
            END
    END AS Address2,

    COALESCE(ADDR.COUNTRY, 'Mandatory to ILOS') AS Country,
    COALESCE(ADDR.STATE, 'Mandatory to ILOS') AS State,
    COALESCE(ADDR.CITY, 'Mandatory to ILOS') AS City,
    COALESCE(ADDR.ZIP, 'Mandatory to ILOS') AS Zip
FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM CUST

LEFT JOIN D360.IBS_REFERENCE REF
    ON REF.CIF_ID = CUST.ORGKEY

LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_ADDRESS ADDR
    ON CUST.ORGKEY = ADDR.ORGKEY
WHERE
    CUST.STRUSERFIELD8 IS NOT NULL
    AND CUST.ISLATEST = 1;

SELECT * FROM D360.IBS_ADDRESS;

IF OBJECT_ID('D360.IBS_CBCACL') IS NOT NULL
    DROP TABLE D360.IBS_CBCACL

CREATE TABLE D360.IBS_CBCACL (
    [CbcAclId] BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
    [CbcCifNumber] VARCHAR(100),
    [AclReportDate] VARCHAR(50) NULL,
    [Brr] VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    [BSPClassification] VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    [CbcAclRemarks] VARCHAR(500) NULL,
    [ImpairmentStage] VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    [TotalFinalAcl] DECIMAL(18,2) NULL
)

WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
    HEAP
);

INSERT INTO D360.IBS_CBCACL (
    [CbcCifNumber],
    [AclReportDate],
    [Brr],
    [BSPClassification],
    [CbcAclRemarks],
    [ImpairmentStage],
    [TotalFinalAcl]
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    COALESCE(CUST.ORGKEY, 'Mandatory to ILOS') AS CbcCifNumber,
    NULL AS AclReportDate,

    CASE 
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate' THEN
            CASE 
                WHEN CMISC.STR20 IN ('BRR1', 'BRR') THEN COALESCE(CMISC.STR21, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
                ELSE 'Mandatory to ILOS'
            END
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail' THEN
            CASE 
                WHEN CUST.RISK_RATING_TYPE IN ('BRR', 'BRR1') THEN COALESCE(CUST.RISK_RATING_NAME, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
                ELSE 'Mandatory to ILOS'
            END
    END AS Brr,

    CASE 
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate' THEN
            CASE 
                WHEN CMISC.STR20 = 'BSP' THEN COALESCE(CMISC.STR21, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
                ELSE 'Mandatory to ILOS'
            END
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail' THEN
            CASE 
                WHEN CUST.RISK_RATING_TYPE = 'BSP' THEN COALESCE(CUST.RISK_RATING_NAME, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
                ELSE 'Mandatory to ILOS'
            END
    END AS BSPClassification,

    NULL AS CbcAclRemarks,
    NULL AS ImpairmentStage,
    NULL AS TotalFinalAcl
FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM CUST

LEFT JOIN D360.IBS_REFERENCE REF
    ON REF.CIF_ID = CUST.ORGKEY

LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_CORPMISCELLANEOUSINFO CMISC
    ON CUST.ORGKEY = CMISC.ORGKEY

WHERE
    CUST.STRUSERFIELD8 IS NOT NULL
    AND CUST.ISLATEST = 1;

SELECT * FROM D360.IBS_CBCACL;

IF OBJECT_ID('D360.IBS_CONTACT') IS NOT NULL
    DROP TABLE D360.IBS_CONTACT

CREATE TABLE D360.IBS_CONTACT (
    [Id] BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
    [CbcCifNumber] VARCHAR(100),
    [CbcContact] VARCHAR(500),
    [CbcContactDetail] VARCHAR(500),
    [CbcContactType] VARCHAR(100),
    [CbcPreferred] VARCHAR(50)
);

INSERT INTO D360.IBS_CONTACT (
    [CbcCifNumber],
    [CbcContact],
    [CbcContactDetail],
    [CbcContactType],
    [CbcPreferred]
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    COALESCE(CUST.ORGKEY, 'Mandatory to ILOS') AS CbcCifNumber,

    CASE 
        WHEN CPE.PHONEOREMAIL = 'EMAIL' THEN
            CASE WHEN ADDR.SUBURB IS NULL
                AND ADDR.PREMISE_NAME IS NULL
                AND ADDR.BUILDING_LEVEL IS NULL
                AND ADDR.STREET_NAME IS NULL THEN 'Mandatory to ILOS'
            ELSE CONCAT(
                    CPE.PHONEEMAILID, ' ',
                    CPE.PHONEOREMAIL, ' ',
                    CPE.PHONEEMAILTYPE
                )
            END
        ELSE
            CASE WHEN CPE.PHONENOCITYCODE IS NULL
                AND CPE.PHONENOCOUNTRYCODE IS NULL
                AND CPE.PHONENOLOCALCODE IS NULL THEN 'Mandatory to ILOS'
            ELSE CONCAT(
                    CPE.PHONENOCITYCODE, ' ',
                    CPE.PHONENOCOUNTRYCODE, ' ',
                    CPE.PHONENOLOCALCODE
                )
            END
    END AS CbcContact,

    CASE 
        WHEN CPE.PHONEOREMAIL = 'EMAIL' THEN
            CASE WHEN CPE.PHONEEMAILID IS NULL
                AND CPE.PHONEOREMAIL IS NULL
                AND CPE.PHONEEMAILTYPE IS NULL THEN 'Mandatory to ILOS'
            ELSE CONCAT(
                CPE.PHONEEMAILID, ' ',
                CPE.PHONEOREMAIL, ' ',
                CPE.PHONEEMAILTYPE
            )
            END
        ELSE
            CASE WHEN CPE.PHONENOCITYCODE IS NULL
                AND CPE.PHONENOCOUNTRYCODE IS NULL
                AND CPE.PHONENOLOCALCODE IS NULL THEN 'Mandatory to ILOS'
            ELSE CONCAT(
                CPE.PHONENOCITYCODE, ' ',
                CPE.PHONENOCOUNTRYCODE, ' ',
                CPE.PHONENOLOCALCODE
            )
            END
    END AS CbcContactDetail,

    COALESCE(CPE.PHONEEMAILTYPE, 'Mandatory to ILOS') AS CbcContactType,

    CASE 
        WHEN CPE.PREFERREDFLAG = 'Y' THEN 'Preferred'
        ELSE 'Mandatory to ILOS'
    END AS CbcPreferred
FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM CUST

LEFT JOIN D360.IBS_REFERENCE REF
    ON REF.CIF_ID = CUST.ORGKEY

LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_PHONEEMAIL CPE
    ON CUST.ORGKEY = CPE.ORGKEY

LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_ADDRESS ADDR
    ON CUST.ORGKEY = ADDR.ORGKEY

WHERE
    CUST.STRUSERFIELD8 IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(CORP.CORPORATE_NAME, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE COALESCE(CUST.CUST_LAST_NAME, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
    END AS LongName,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(CORP.SHORT_NAME, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE COALESCE(CUST.SHORT_NAME, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
    END AS ShortName,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(CORP.LEGALENTITY_TYPE, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE 'CUSTOMER'
    END AS EntityType,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(REF.BusinessPortfolio, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS BusinessPortfolio,

    CUST.ORGKEY AS CbcCifNumber,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(REF.CreditPortfolio, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CreditPortfolio,

    'N' AS Prospect,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(CORP.TAXID, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE COALESCE(CUST.GENERALTAXID, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
    END AS TaxId,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(CORP.COUNTRYOFINCORPORATION, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CountryOfInc,

    -- CASE
    --     WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
    --         THEN COALESCE(CORP.DATE_OF_INCORPORATION, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
    --     ELSE NULL
    -- END AS CbcRegistrationDate,
    NULL AS CbcRegistrationDate,

    -- CASE
    --     WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
    --         THEN COALESCE(CORP.REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
    --     ELSE NULL
    -- END AS RegistrationNumber,
    NULL AS RegistrationNumber,

    -- CASE
    --     WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
    --         THEN CORP.STRUSERFIELD10
    --     ELSE NULL
    -- END AS CbcCooperativeId,
    NULL AS CbcCooperativeId,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(CORP.STRUSERFIELD22, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE COALESCE(CUST.STRUSERFIELD22, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
    END AS ConnectedParty,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(CORP.STRUSERFIELD23, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE COALESCE(CUST.STRUSERFIELD23, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
    END AS CbcRelatedParty,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN CORP.STRUSERFIELD24
        ELSE CUST.STRUSERFIELD24
    END AS Descriptions,

    GHH.GROUPHOUSEHOLDNAME AS CbcGroupName,
    GHH.GROUPHOUSEHOLDID AS CbcGroupId,

    42680364174 AS CbcSingleBorrowerLimit,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN CORP.DATE4
        ELSE CUST.DTDATE4
    END AS CbcBorrowerSince,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN CORP.DATE3
        ELSE CUST.DTDATE5
    END AS CbcDepositorSince,

    NULL AS LastReviewDate,
    NULL AS NextReviewDate,
    NULL AS Division,
    'N' AS RestrictedEntity,
    
    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(REF.PrimaryBankingOfficer, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS PrimaryBankingOfficer,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(REF.PrimaryCreditOfficer, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS PrimaryCreditOfficer,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(CORP.KEYCONTACT_PERSONNAME, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CbcContactName,

    NULL AS FirmType,
    
    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(REF.CountryOfRisk, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CountryOfRisk,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(REF.Currency, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS Currency,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(FIN.STR7, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CbcFirmSize,

    NULL AS CbcGenderOfCompany,
    NULL AS ListingDate,
    NULL AS CountryOfListing,
    NULL AS StockExchange,
    NULL AS StockCode,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate'
            THEN COALESCE(REF.IndClassification, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS IndClassification,
    NULL AS CbcNatureOfBusiness,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN COALESCE(CUST.SALUTATION, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS Salutation,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN COALESCE(CUST.CUST_FIRST_NAME, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CbcFirstName,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN COALESCE(CUST.CUST_MIDDLE_NAME, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CbcMiddleName,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN COALESCE(CUST.NAMESUFFIX, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CbcSuffix,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN COALESCE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),CUST.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE,120), 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CustomerSince,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN COALESCE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),CUST.CUST_DOB,120), 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS DateOfBirth,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN COALESCE(DEMO.NATIONALITY, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS Nationality1,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN COALESCE(DEMO.RESIDENCE_COUNTRY, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CountryOfRes,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN COALESCE(CUST.GENDER, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS Gender,

    NULL AS CbcNoOfDependents,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN COALESCE(DEMO.RESIDENTIAL_STATUS, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CbcHomeOwnership,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN COALESCE(EMP.STRTEXT2, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CbcOccupation,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN COALESCE(DEMO.EMPLOYERSNAME, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CurrentEmp,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN COALESCE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), EMP.DTDATE1, 120), 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS CbcEmploymentDate,

    CASE
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
            THEN COALESCE(EMP.STRTEXT9, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
        ELSE NULL
    END AS Designation,

    NULL AS BusinessType,
    NULL AS CbcRelatedPartyClassIndividual,

    CAST(1 AS BIT) AS CbcIsNonSystemUser

FROM D360.IBS_REFERENCE REF 

LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM CUST
    ON REF.CIF_ID = CUST.ORGKEY
    AND CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE IN ('Corporate', 'Retail')
    AND CUST.STRUSERFIELD8 IS NOT NULL
    AND CUST.ISLATEST = 1

LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_CORPORATE CORP
    ON CORP.CORP_KEY = CUST.ORGKEY

LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD GHH
    ON GHH.ORGKEY = CUST.ORGKEY

LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_FINANCIAL FIN
    ON FIN.ORGKEY = CUST.ORGKEY

LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC DEMO
    ON DEMO.ORGKEY = CUST.ORGKEY

LEFT JOIN CURRENT_EMPLOYMENT EMP
    ON EMP.ORGKEY = CUST.ORGKEY
    AND EMP.RN = 1

CREATE TABLE D360.IBS_ADDRESS_v2 (
    [AddressId] BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
    [CbcCifNumber] VARCHAR(100),
    [AddressType] VARCHAR(100),
    [Address1] VARCHAR(500),
    [Address2] VARCHAR(500),
    [Country] VARCHAR(100),
    [State] VARCHAR(100),
    [City] VARCHAR(100),
    [Zip] VARCHAR(50)
)

WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
    HEAP
);

INSERT INTO D360.IBS_ADDRESS_v2 (
    [CbcCifNumber],
    [AddressType],
    [Address1],
    [Address2],
    [Country],
    [State],
    [City],
    [Zip]
)

SELECT DISTINCT
    COALESCE(CUST.ORGKEY, 'Mandatory to ILOS') AS CbcCifNumber,
    COALESCE(ADDR.ADDRESSCATEGORY, 'Mandatory to ILOS') AS AddressType,

    CASE 
        WHEN ADDR.PREFERREDFORMAT = 'STRUCTURED_FORMAT' THEN
            CASE WHEN ADDR.SUBURB IS NULL
                AND ADDR.PREMISE_NAME IS NULL
                AND ADDR.BUILDING_LEVEL IS NULL
                AND ADDR.STREET_NAME IS NULL THEN 'Mandatory to ILOS'
            ELSE CONCAT(
                    ADDR.SUBURB, ' ',
                    ADDR.PREMISE_NAME, ' ',
                    ADDR.BUILDING_LEVEL, ' ',
                    ADDR.STREET_NAME
            )
            END
        ELSE
            COALESCE(ADDR.ADDRESS_LINE1, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
    END AS Address1,

    CASE 
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate' THEN
            CASE 
                WHEN ADDR.PREFERREDFORMAT = 'STRUCTURED_FORMAT' THEN
                    CASE WHEN ADDR.SUBURB IS NULL
                        AND ADDR.PREMISE_NAME IS NULL
                        AND ADDR.BUILDING_LEVEL IS NULL
                        AND ADDR.STREET_NAME IS NULL THEN 'Mandatory to ILOS'
                    ELSE CONCAT(
                        ADDR.SUBURB, ' ',
                        ADDR.PREMISE_NAME, ' ',
                        ADDR.BUILDING_LEVEL, ' ',
                        ADDR.STREET_NAME
                    ) 
                    END
                ELSE
                    CASE WHEN ADDR.ADDRESS_LINE2 IS NULL
                        AND ADDR.ADDRESS_LINE3 IS NULL THEN 'Mandatory to ILOS'
                    ELSE CONCAT(
                            ADDR.ADDRESS_LINE2, ' ',
                            ADDR.ADDRESS_LINE3, ' ',
                            ADDR.PREFERREDFORMAT
                    ) 
                    END
            END
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail' THEN
            CASE WHEN ADDR.ADDRESS_LINE2 IS NULL
                AND ADDR.ADDRESS_LINE3 IS NULL THEN 'Mandatory to ILOS'
            ELSE CONCAT(
                ADDR.ADDRESS_LINE2, ' ',
                ADDR.ADDRESS_LINE3
            )
            END
    END AS Address2,

    COALESCE(ADDR.COUNTRY, 'Mandatory to ILOS') AS Country,
    COALESCE(ADDR.STATE, 'Mandatory to ILOS') AS State,
    COALESCE(ADDR.CITY, 'Mandatory to ILOS') AS City,
    COALESCE(ADDR.ZIP, 'Mandatory to ILOS') AS Zip
FROM D360.IBS_REFERENCE REF

LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM CUST
    ON REF.CIF_ID = CUST.ORGKEY

LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_ADDRESS ADDR
    ON CUST.ORGKEY = ADDR.ORGKEY
WHERE
    CUST.STRUSERFIELD8 IS NOT NULL
    AND CUST.ISLATEST = 1;

    [CbcAclId] BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
    [CbcCifNumber] VARCHAR(100),
    [AclReportDate] VARCHAR(50) NULL,
    [Brr] VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    [BSPClassification] VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    [CbcAclRemarks] VARCHAR(500) NULL,
    [ImpairmentStage] VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    [TotalFinalAcl] DECIMAL(18,2) NULL
)

    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
    HEAP
);

INSERT INTO D360.IBS_CBCACL_v2 (
    [CbcCifNumber],
    [AclReportDate],
    [Brr],
    [BSPClassification],
    [CbcAclRemarks],
    [ImpairmentStage],
    [TotalFinalAcl]
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    COALESCE(CUST.ORGKEY, 'Mandatory to ILOS') AS CbcCifNumber,
    NULL AS AclReportDate,

    CASE 
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate' THEN
            CASE 
                WHEN CMISC.STR20 IN ('BRR1', 'BRR') THEN COALESCE(CMISC.STR21, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
                ELSE 'Mandatory to ILOS'
            END
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail' THEN
            CASE 
                WHEN CUST.RISK_RATING_TYPE IN ('BRR', 'BRR1') THEN COALESCE(CUST.RISK_RATING_NAME, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
                ELSE 'Mandatory to ILOS'
            END
    END AS Brr,

    CASE 
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Corporate' THEN
            CASE 
                WHEN CMISC.STR20 = 'BSP' THEN COALESCE(CMISC.STR21, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
                ELSE 'Mandatory to ILOS'
            END
        WHEN CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail' THEN
            CASE 
                WHEN CUST.RISK_RATING_TYPE = 'BSP' THEN COALESCE(CUST.RISK_RATING_NAME, 'Mandatory to ILOS')
                ELSE 'Mandatory to ILOS'
            END
    END AS BSPClassification,

    NULL AS CbcAclRemarks,
    NULL AS ImpairmentStage,
    NULL AS TotalFinalAcl
FROM D360.IBS_REFERENCE REF

LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM CUST
    ON REF.CIF_ID = CUST.ORGKEY

LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_CORPMISCELLANEOUSINFO CMISC
    ON CUST.ORGKEY = CMISC.ORGKEY

WHERE
    CUST.STRUSERFIELD8 IS NOT NULL
    AND CUST.ISLATEST = 1;

CREATE TABLE D360.IBS_CONTACT_v2 (
    [Id] BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
    [CbcCifNumber] VARCHAR(100),
    [CbcContact] VARCHAR(500),
    [CbcContactDetail] VARCHAR(500),
    [CbcContactType] VARCHAR(100),
    [CbcPreferred] VARCHAR(50)
);

INSERT INTO D360.IBS_CONTACT_v2 (
    [CbcCifNumber],
    [CbcContact],
    [CbcContactDetail],
    [CbcContactType],
    [CbcPreferred]
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    COALESCE(CUST.ORGKEY, 'Mandatory to ILOS') AS CbcCifNumber,

    CASE 
        WHEN CPE.PHONEOREMAIL = 'EMAIL' THEN
            CASE WHEN ADDR.SUBURB IS NULL
                AND ADDR.PREMISE_NAME IS NULL
                AND ADDR.BUILDING_LEVEL IS NULL
                AND ADDR.STREET_NAME IS NULL THEN 'Mandatory to ILOS'
            ELSE CONCAT(
                    CPE.PHONEEMAILID, ' ',
                    CPE.PHONEOREMAIL, ' ',
                    CPE.PHONEEMAILTYPE
                )
            END
        ELSE
            CASE WHEN CPE.PHONENOCITYCODE IS NULL
                AND CPE.PHONENOCOUNTRYCODE IS NULL
                AND CPE.PHONENOLOCALCODE IS NULL THEN 'Mandatory to ILOS'
            ELSE CONCAT(
                    CPE.PHONENOCITYCODE, ' ',
                    CPE.PHONENOCOUNTRYCODE, ' ',
                    CPE.PHONENOLOCALCODE
                )
            END
    END AS CbcContact,

    CASE 
        WHEN CPE.PHONEOREMAIL = 'EMAIL' THEN
            CASE WHEN CPE.PHONEEMAILID IS NULL
                AND CPE.PHONEOREMAIL IS NULL
                AND CPE.PHONEEMAILTYPE IS NULL THEN 'Mandatory to ILOS'
            ELSE CONCAT(
                CPE.PHONEEMAILID, ' ',
                CPE.PHONEOREMAIL, ' ',
                CPE.PHONEEMAILTYPE
            )
            END
        ELSE
            CASE WHEN CPE.PHONENOCITYCODE IS NULL
                AND CPE.PHONENOCOUNTRYCODE IS NULL
                AND CPE.PHONENOLOCALCODE IS NULL THEN 'Mandatory to ILOS'
            ELSE CONCAT(
                CPE.PHONENOCITYCODE, ' ',
                CPE.PHONENOCOUNTRYCODE, ' ',
                CPE.PHONENOLOCALCODE
            )
            END
    END AS CbcContactDetail,

    COALESCE(CPE.PHONEEMAILTYPE, 'Mandatory to ILOS') AS CbcContactType,

    CASE 
        WHEN CPE.PREFERREDFLAG = 'Y' THEN 'Preferred'
        ELSE 'Mandatory to ILOS'
    END AS CbcPreferred
FROM D360.IBS_REFERENCE REF

LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM CUST
    ON REF.CIF_ID = CUST.ORGKEY

LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_PHONEEMAIL CPE
    ON CUST.ORGKEY = CPE.ORGKEY

LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_ADDRESS ADDR
    ON CUST.ORGKEY = ADDR.ORGKEY

WHERE
    CUST.STRUSERFIELD8 IS NOT NULL
    AND CUST.ISLATEST = 1;
